Run npm run screenshots:save first.`);' + "`r`n" + '    }' + "`r`n" + '  }' + "`r`n" + '}')
$t = $t.Replace('page.on("console", (message) => {' + "`r`n" + '    if (message.type() === "error") errors.push(message.text());' + "`r`n" + '  });', 'page.on("console", (message) => {' + "`r`n" + '    if (message.type() === "error" && !message.location().url?.endsWith("/favicon.ico")) {' + "`r`n" + '      errors.push(message.text());' + "`r`n" + '    }' + "`r`n" + '  });')
$t = $t.Replace('page.on("console", (message) => {' + "`r`n" + '      if (message.type() === "error") errors.push(message.text());' + "`r`n" + '    });', 'page.on("console", (message) => {' + "`r`n" + '      if (message.type() === "error" && !message.location().url?.endsWith("/favicon.ico")) {' + "`r`n" + '        errors.push(message.text());' + "`r`n" + '      }' + "`r`n" + '    });')
$t = $t.Replace('console.log(`Chrome: ${executablePath}`);', 'console.log(`Chrome: ${executablePath}`);' + "`r`n" + '  console.log(`Mode: ${SAVE ? "save deliverable screenshots" : "verify only (temp screenshots)"}`);')
$t = $t.Replace('roomScreenshot: "screenshots/pixel-room-1440.png",', 'roomScreenshot: "screenshots/pixel-room-1440.png",' + "`r`n" + '    mode: SAVE ? "save" : "verify",')
Set-Content -Path $p -Value $t -NoNewline -Encoding ascii
$pkg = Get-Content -Raw package.json
$pkg = $pkg.Replace('"screenshots": "node scripts/screenshots.mjs",', '"screenshots": "node scripts/screenshots.mjs",' + "`r`n" + '    "screenshots:save": "node scripts/screenshots.mjs --save",')
Set-Content -Path package.json -Value $pkg -NoNewline -Encoding ascii
Select-String -Path scripts\screenshots.mjs -Pattern 'SAVE|os.tmpdir|favicon.ico|DELIVERABLES' | Select-Object LineNumber,Line
